articles.title: Strait of Hormuz: U.S. Makes Progress, But Iran War Drags On
articles.summary: The U.S. has loosened Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil route. But the war continues, oil prices are above $100, and experts see no clear winner. Iran's oil exports have plummeted.

articles.title: Cyclospora Outbreak Ends, But the Source Remains a Mystery
articles.summary: U.S. officials declared an end to a record cyclospora outbreak that sickened nearly 20,000 people. It was linked to iceberg lettuce from Mexico, but the exact origin is still unknown.

articles.title: CDC Under Fire: Measles Deaths, Missing Data, and a Crisis of Trust
articles.summary: The U.S. is facing its worst measles outbreak in decades. When Pennsylvania reported two measles deaths, the CDC removed them from its website after Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. questioned them. Now public health experts worry: can we trust the CDC?
